notes: r3 investigation (2026-10-17): 5 real formed bends. The two side-wall 'back-half folds' (3|5 and 4|6, round-1 B3/B5) are NOT bends. Raw-mesh and downsampled sections behind the crease relief holes show the back-floor end face and the wall's bottom-edge face, with an empty outer corner and no arc on either skin. A cut-face test finds cut-edge faces at 25/27 (left) and 20/27 (right) back-half stations, against 0/47 and 2/47 stations along the folded front half. The walls are folded from the front floor only, and the crease relief holes start the slits. Physical scan: uniform 0.5 mm mesh; the +U-facing wall skins were not scanned.

bends.note: Front lip fold, about 74 deg bend (106 deg included), outer skin. Runs from corner relief to corner relief (about 106 mm). Both arcs are present in every section.

Left wall fold, from the FRONT floor only, 90 deg, outer skin. Runs from the front corner relief to the crease relief hole (about 56 mm). Behind the crease relief the wall is not folded: floor 5 only butts against it (step profile, cut faces, no arc).

Right wall fold, from the FRONT floor only, about 88 deg, inner skin (the wall's outer skin was not scanned). Runs from the front corner relief to the crease relief hole (about 57 mm). Behind that relief, floor 6 meets the wall at a sharp inner corner, with the wall's bottom-edge face (patch 18) beside it: a butt joint, not a fold.

Floor crease, 17 deg bend, outer skin. Two flat floor planes meet at a localized kink (about 4-6 mm transition on both skins), with relief holes at both ends. This is a formed shallow bend, not a rolled surface. Runs relief to relief (about 106 mm).

Back-right tab fold. The physical bend from floor 5 to tab 9 is about 113 deg (66.7 deg included). Patch 11 is the gently curved run-in that carries the first ~13.7 deg, so the 11|9 pair reports about 80 deg included. 11|9 is used because the 5|9 plane intersection is skewed 2.5 deg to the arc axis: 5+11|9 drifted up to 1.4 mm off the arc. 11|9 and the inner-skin pair 12|10 agree within 0.05 deg, and the 11|9 apex stays within 0.3 mm of the scanned arc ridge along its whole length. Covers 37.2 of the 38.3 mm tab (97%).
